entry: Added tooltips to the Trade Link and Regional Partner buttons explaining what each actually buys, closing an onboarding gap for players who skipped the tutorial.

Added a settings panel (text size + reduced motion) and completed a colorblind-safety audit — the linear-chain brown vs. closed-loop green flow particle is already redundantly coded via text and arrow brightness, no change needed.

Achievements system added (20 achievements) plus a large H1-H20 backlog pass: a goods-category picker, a second trade partner, a closed-loop streak tracker, a live score breakdown, and reactive visual pulses on investment.
Full visual redesign: starfield/space-themed backdrop, glass panels, gradient buttons and glowing meter fills.
Fixed load_state() wholesale-replacing circularity investments on load instead of merging key-by-key against the current investment schema.
Pass 3 balance check: confirmed the single-item vignette already gives immediate, strategy-reflective feedback tied to the live circular-supply fraction; added regression tests to lock it in.
Added an in-game Info Page with real-world circular-economy sources; Pass 2 added a trade network and a single-item vignette alongside the abstract flow-chain view.
Iteration pass: animated chain-flow particles (color-coded circular vs. linear paths) and an end-of-session real-world circularity-rate comparison.

All 7 core milestones shipped: linear extraction chain, circularity investments, environmental cost meter, loop-closure visualization, scoring + hope-angle payoff, feedback prompt, and hub integration.
